name: dropzone
title: Dropzone
description: Drag and drop file area with size check and removable file list.
htmlExample:
<bef-dropzone id="dz" style="width:380px" accept="image/*" hint="Drop images here or click to browse"></bef-dropzone>
<script>const dz = document.getElementById('dz'); const setFiles = (files) => dz.props = { files, onFilesChange: setFiles }; setFiles([]);</script>
